quandoUsar: Deep pages in a hierarchy, such as Workspace › Projects › Mobile app › Releases, so people can go back to any level.
Folder or category browsers where the path lives in local state: items with `onClick` and no `href` become buttons.
Paths that grow as the person descends the tree: new levels slide in at the end.
quandoEvitar: Use `stepper` to show the progress of a multi-step flow; the trail shows location, not progress.
Use `tabs` to switch between sibling views at the same level.
Use `pagination` to move through the pages of a collection.
acessibilidade: Renders a `<nav>` with `aria-label` (default “Breadcrumb”, in English) and an ordered list; the arrows between levels are hidden from the screen reader.
The last item is always the current page: it becomes text with `aria-current="page"`, even if it has `href`.
movimento: Items from the first render stay still; levels added later slide in 8 px from the left, out of a slight blur, and removed ones disappear in a short fade.
The items that remain reposition on a no-overshoot spring, and each reserves the label width at medium weight, so becoming the current page does not shift the path.
With “reduce motion” on, entries, exits, and repositioning happen instantly.
responsivo: The list wraps onto several lines when it does not fit (`flex-wrap`), but each label stays on a single line; there is no ellipsis or collapsing of the middle levels.
notasIA: Pass the whole path in `items`, with the current page last; use `href` for real routes and `onClick` without `href` for paths in local state.
Links go through `RyanProvider`: with it, `next/link` or your router's Link is used in place of the `<a>`.
Change `ariaLabel` to Portuguese, for example “Trilha de navegação”, since the default is “Breadcrumb”. Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/breadcrumb/breadcrumb`.
